projectRef.description: Project UUID or live slug, or an unexpired slug alias. Expired aliases return 404 PROJECT_NOT_FOUND. POST does not 301.
projectRef.name: project_ref

is_platform_admin.description: True for platform superusers. Project-only members are false.

last_login_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent successful HTTP login, or null if the account has never signed in.

last_login_ip.description: Client IP of the most recent successful HTTP login, or null if unknown or never signed in.

AdminAnnouncement.description: Admin-plane announcement including drafts and scope fields. List and reorder omit content; GET, POST, and PATCH include the markdown body.

content.description: Markdown body. Omitted on list and reorder responses.

language.description: Language code for this row (one language per announcement).

version_id.description: Bound Version UUID; null when not version-scoped. No foreign key.

AdminLoginInput.description: Credentials required for instance administrator login.

AdminLoginOutput.description: Password login or 2FA step result. status=pending returns pending_token and stage; status=complete returns access_token and admin.

access_token.description: Opaque session token present when status=complete.

admin.description: Administrator profile. Present on complete login.

expires_in.description: Token validity duration in seconds. Full sessions use idle TTL; pending tokens use login_pending_ttl_seconds.

has_passkey.description: true when the pending account has at least one registered passkey; only present when status=pending and stage=second_factor.

pending_token.description: Short-lived restricted token present when status=pending.

recovery_codes.description: Plaintext recovery codes, returned once after TOTP confirm or regenerate.

secret.description: TOTP base32 secret during setup. Never logged or cached.

status.description: pending requires additional 2FA or enrollment steps; complete is a full session.

AdminPatchInput.description: Partial administrator update. Empty or omitted password means no password change.

password.description: New password; omit or empty to leave unchanged.

username.description: New username; omit or empty to leave unchanged.

confirmed.description: Must be true to acknowledge recovery codes were saved.

credential.description: WebAuthn attestation or assertion JSON from the authenticator.

name.description: Display name for a newly registered passkey.

options.description: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions or RequestOptions from the WebAuthn ceremony.

AdminWriteInput.description: Username and password for creating an administrator account. Both fields required on POST.

Artifact.description: Downloadable file or package binary associated with a specific platform version line.

artifact_signature.description: Detached cryptographic signature over the file bytes.

compatible_hw_revs.description: List of explicitly compatible hardware revisions.

content_type.description: MIME media type for HTTP Content-Type header.

kind.description: Artifact category: full (hash-root native), store_full (path zip for stores), delta, patch, file.

version_line_id.description: ID of the associated Version Line.

AuditListOutput.description: Paginated list of administrative audit events.

actor_fingerprint.description: Username or token fingerprint (never a plaintext token).

actor_type.description: Actor type: admin, project_token, or ci_token.

project_id.description: Owning project UUID when the event is project-scoped.

next_cursor.description: Cursor token for the next page; empty when no more events.

AutoPublishRule.description: Gating rule for publishing when required platform lines are ready (required_lines like windows/x86_64).

allow_partial.description: When true, publish even if some required lines are missing (default false).

BuildInfo.description: Build identity of this process. version/commit/build_time come from linker injection in the release toolchain; a binary built without injection reports dev and unknown instead of failing.

build_time.description: Build timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC as injected by the release toolchain. "unknown" when nothing was injected: the process never guesses a compile time from its own start time.

cgo_enabled.description: True when this binary links C/C++ code (the official server build always does). Comes from the build constraint, not from injection.

commit.description: Source revision this binary was built from: short SHA, with a -dirty suffix when the worktree was modified. "unknown" when neither injection nor VCS stamping supplied it.

go_version.description: Go toolchain version running this process (runtime fact, never injected).

platform.description: Build target as goos/goarch (runtime fact, never injected).

version.description: Release version without a v prefix. "dev" for anything the release toolchain did not build, so an operator can tell a local binary from an official one.

CIReleasesOutput.description: Response returned when an automated CI release bundle is accepted for background processing.

job_id.description: UUID of the asynchronous bundle unpacking job.

status.description: Initial state of the background job.

CIToken.description: Restricted continuous integration token used by CI/CD runners to publish releases.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the token used for audit and per-token rate limiting.

name.description: Label identifying the CI pipeline or runner.

scopes.description: Granted scopes restricted to automated CI workflows.

token.description: Plaintext kvc_… shown only on create

ChangelogEntry.description: Release changelog content including title and Markdown text for a specific locale.

ChangelogMap.description: Locale-keyed changelog map (e.g. zh-CN, en) of ChangelogEntry values.

Channel.description: Distribution channel representing a stability track (e.g. stable, beta, alpha, lts).

enabled.description: Whether new versions can be published to this channel.

name.description: Required display name. Seeded at project create from system_channel_names or English slugs.

slug.description: Custom slugs match ^[a-z0-9-]{3,64}$; underscore is rejected. lts is allowed and does not set Version is_lts.

token.description: Plaintext channel token. Empty when unset or when only a legacy hash exists.

token_required.description: True when a channel token hash is stored.

unlisted.description: Hidden from public catalog and not an auto-upgrade target unless the client is already on this channel or query channel matches.

cleaned_count.description: Number of expired or abandoned upload sessions and unreferenced artifacts removed.

Client.description: Project client registry row. device_hash follows device_id_policy; raw device_id is never returned.

country_code.description: ISO country code from fused GeoIP; empty when unknown.

region_code.description: ISO region/subdivision code; empty when unknown.

failed_count.description: Telemetry failed events on this UTC day.

installed_count.description: Telemetry installed events on this UTC day.

names.description: Fused country names for this code.

DeleteTelemetryOutput.description: Result of privacy data erasure for a device identifier.

allowlist_deleted.description: Count of gray allowlist entries erased.

Error.description: Standard unified error envelope format: { error: { code, message, details } }.

GeoI18n.description: Fused locale maps for country and region names. No single-language country_name.

ClusterNode.description: A process identity row on shared Postgres. Heartbeat is local UPDATE, not HTTP.

is_current.description: True when this row is the admin process serving this request.

cluster_active.description: True when this process is in cluster mode (storage.driver=s3 and cache.driver=redis). Independent of node row count.

NodeArtifactSync.description: Per-node replica progress for a version line.

GrayAllowlistDeleteOutput.description: Result of removing device identifiers from the gray rollout allowlist.

GrayAllowlistEntry.description: Gray allowlist entry. device_id is the stored form: HMAC hex under the hashed policy, raw value under the raw policy. Plaintext is never echoed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the device was added to allowlist.

source.description: auto = incremental gray admission; manual = operator selected the device from the registry.

GrayAllowlistList.description: List of device identifiers explicitly enrolled in the gray rollout allowlist.

GrayAllowlistWriteInput.description: client_ids are namebook UUIDs (not raw device_id). Policy none is rejected with 400.

client_ids.description: Registered client UUIDs to add or remove from the version allowlist.

GrayPatchInput.description: Patch incremental gray knobs. Does not reset gray_started_at.

gray_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between coverage ticks. k = floor(elapsed / interval).

gray_start_percent.description: Starting gray coverage percent at t=0. 100 (default) publishes as full push.

gray_step_percent.description: Coverage percent added after each interval tick.

GrayStatus.description: Version JSON plus incremental gray KPIs.

HwRev.description: Hardware revision definition defining an ordered hardware generation for an embedded or physical device.

notes.description: Optional release notes or description for this hardware revision.

rank.description: Integer rank establishing the hardware revision timeline ordering.

slug.description: Hardware generation slug. After normalize must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ (v1 allowed; independent of OS/Arch min-3).

Job.description: Asynchronous background task (e.g. bundle unpacking, delta generation, archive packaging).

error_message.description: Detailed error message if the job failed.

job_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) of the background job.

result.description: Structured output upon successful job completion.

LineDefaultsOutput.description: Prefill values from the highest compare-key version strictly below the current version that has the requested line. Nulls if none.

ManifestEntry.description: Single file record in a multi-file version line manifest.

integrity_check.description: Whether client integrity verification should validate this file.

md5.description: Hex-encoded MD5 checksum of the file.

path.description: Normalized relative file path (forward slashes, Unicode NFC).

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the file.

ManifestResult.description: Multi-file manifest summary with calculated root hash and entry count.

count.description: Total number of files in the manifest.

root_hash.description: Composite Merkle-like root hash computed over sorted normalized file entries.

InstallPolicyEntry.description: Path install policy in a project or channel template.

InstallPolicyReferenceOutput.description: Latest non-revoked version on the selected channel for the matrix pair, plus that line's Manifest entries.

status.description: Version status when version is set.

version.description: Display version of the latest non-revoked Version on the channel; null when the channel has none.

MediaUploadFile.description: One uploaded Markdown media object with hashes.

password.description: When set, creates is_platform_admin=false. Omit to attach an existing account.

PlatformCatalogOutput.description: Catalog of preset operating systems and CPU architectures with recognized aliases.

arch.description: List of supported CPU architecture metadata entries.

slug.description: Canonical architecture slug (e.g. x86_64, arm64, x86).

os.description: List of supported operating system metadata entries.

slug.description: Canonical operating system slug (e.g. windows, linux, macos, android).

PlatformMatrix.description: Platform matrix row defining supported OS, CPU architecture, package type, and delta rules. Minimum OS/API live on VersionLine.

delta_source_count.description: Number of recent historical versions to pre-generate delta patches against (default: 3).

id.description: Unique platform matrix entry identifier (UUID v4).

minimum_supported_version.description: Null falls back to the project field

os.description: Stored canonical (darwin/osx → macos). ipados is stored as-is to enable a distinct matrix row.

package_type.description: Package packaging mode ('single_file' or 'multi_file'). Immutable once published.

PresignUploadOutput.description: API or TUS upload URL. Artifact bytes are never PUT to unknown S3 keys.

direct_s3.description: Always false. Incoming artifacts write local temp then promote to {slug}/{sha256}.

upload_url.description: Presigned HTTP PUT URL or API relay upload endpoint.

Project.description: Core project domain entity providing tenant isolation, security, storage, and update policies.

cache_s_maxage_seconds.description: CDN shared-cache s-maxage seconds applied to changelog, integrity and feeds. Native POST /update/check never uses public s-maxage.

changelog_client_override.description: Whether client requests are allowed to override default changelog scope and layout.

changelog_include_platform_notes.description: Whether to append platform slice notes to the version changelog.

changelog_include_revoked.description: Whether to include revoked versions in historical changelogs.

compare_engine.description: Version comparison engine ('semver' or 'integer'). Immutable once first version is published.

cors_origins.description: Allowed CORS origins for browser-based web clients or extensions.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created (UTC ISO-8601).

default_locale.description: Denormalized copy of the default project language code. Required on POST create; PATCH upserts the language row and flips is_default.

device_id_policy.description: Storage policy for device identifiers: 'hashed' (HMAC-SHA256), 'raw', or 'none'.

store_token.description: Plaintext only when set on this write

force_https.description: When true, client downloads and redirects enforce HTTPS URLs.

gray_weight_tenure_activity.description: When true (default), auto gray admission ranks by tenure×recency. When false, created_at,id ASC.

has_store_token.description: Indicates whether a dedicated store authentication token is configured.

has_signing_private_key.description: True if the server possesses the private key for signing release manifests.

minimum_supported_version.description: Global floor version string. Clients below this are forced to update (is_mandatory=true).

name.description: Human-readable display title. Not unique and never used as project_ref. Omitted on create defaults to slug.

rate_limit.description: Default bag: check_per_device_per_minute=60, check_per_ip_per_minute=120, store_per_ip_per_minute=300, diff_per_device_per_minute=20, diff_per_ip_per_minute=60, telemetry_per_device_per_minute=30, ci_per_token_per_minute=600. 429 is enforced in a later task.

require_client_token.description: When true, update checks and downloads require a valid ProjectToken in the header.

signed_url_ttl_seconds.description: TTL in seconds for short-lived signed download URLs of private-storage projects (docs/app-init.md 13.7). 0 means the instance default of 3600 (1 hour). Path and filename stay stable; the signature lives only in the query (exp, sig).

signing_algo.description: Cryptographic signing algorithm for manifests and check responses ('ed25519' or 'rsa').

signing_public_key.description: PEM-encoded public key used for response signature verification.

signing_private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key. Write-only; never returned on GET or list.

slug.description: URL-safe project identifier (alphanumeric, dashes, underscores; 3-64 characters).

telemetry_retention_days.description: Days to retain telemetry events. Default 90. Negative values are rejected; 0 is treated as 90.

storage_bucket.description: Target object storage bucket name for project artifacts. Hidden in the admin UI when storage_driver is local.

storage_driver.description: Process-wide object storage driver. Read-only; not a per-project setting.

storage_prefix.description: Optional path prefix. After trim and stripping leading/trailing slashes, no path segment may equal the project slug (case-insensitive). Empty is allowed. Does not rewrite ArtifactObjectKey.

storage_visibility.description: Storage object visibility. Writes must be public; private is rejected with 400. Existing private rows may still appear on GET until patched.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the project settings were last modified (UTC ISO-8601).

uuid.description: Immutable unique identifier (UUID v4) of the project.

webhook_secret_reset.description: Set true on PATCH to rotate the webhook signing secret. Never returned in GET or list responses.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS endpoint notified via signed POST webhook upon version publication or revocation.

file_list_max_files.description: Per-project file_list pending-file cap. 0 inherits the platform ceiling (file_list_max_files_limit).

file_list_max_files_limit.description: Read-only platform ceiling for file_list.max_files. PATCH file_list_max_files above this value is 400.

changelog_default_entries.description: Changelog entries when from_version is omitted. Must be 1…changelog_default_entries_limit and not exceed the effective max.

changelog_max_entries.description: Changelog (from, to] truncation cap. 0 inherits changelog_max_entries_limit. PATCH above the instance ceiling is 400.

ProjectLanguage.description: Per-project language row used by announcement and changelog editors.

code.description: Language code as typed (case preserved, e.g. zh-CN). Unique per project case-insensitively.

display_name.description: Optional operator label. Empty string means the UI should show code.

is_default.description: Exactly one language per project is default. Mirrors projects.default_locale.

version.description: Display version (semver if set, otherwise integer).

ProjectStats.description: Aggregated catalog, storage, token, telemetry and 7-day active client counts for admin list/get.

active_7d.description: Distinct namebook devices with last_check_at in the last 7 days.

storage_bytes.description: Sum of artifact size once per distinct storage_key (reuse-safe).

ProjectToken.description: Scoped API token associated with a project for automated integrations.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp (UTC ISO-8601), or null if non-expiring.

token.description: Plaintext kv_… shown only on create

active.description: Tokens with null expiry or expires_at in the future.

PutManifestRequest.description: Request payload containing file entries to build or update a multi-file manifest.

StatusOutput.description: Health response. status is process liveness; ready is database and storage.

ready.description: True when PostgreSQL Ping and object-storage Head of the probe key both succeed.

status.description: Process status; ok while the listener is up.

StoreListing.description: Project store listing (project_store_listings). Protocol is Adapter.Protocol() (sparkle, electron, …), not UI-old electron-updater. Duplicate (protocol, slug) is 400.

arch.description: Optional pin; non-empty ignores conflicting query arch.

channel.description: Optional pin; non-empty ignores conflicting query channel.

store_url.description: Relative store URL including listing slug and the protocol default document.

identifiers.description: Protocol identifier bag (bundle id, PackageIdentifier, homepage, …).

manifest_path.description: Required when package_source is manifest_path; relative manifest path.

os.description: Optional pin; non-empty ignores conflicting query os.

protocol.description: Adapter Protocol() name: sparkle, electron, tauri, squirrel, clickonce, appimage, winget, msix, fdroid.

slug.description: Feed identity; same rules as channel slug [a-z0-9-]{3,64}, no underscore.

UploadArtifactInput.description: Metadata for creating or presigning direct artifact uploads.

artifact_signature.description: Detached cryptographic signature over the file bytes.

size.description: Byte length of the artifact file.

Version.description: Project-level software release containing version identifiers, release notes, and incremental gray state.

actual_percent.description: Live gray actual coverage (allowlisted/N*100) while gray is in progress; 100 after full push. Omitted on drafts that never started gray.

changelog.description: Locale-keyed release notes as stored on the Version (GET).

git_commit.description: Git commit SHA associated with this build.

git_log_from.description: Starting git commit SHA for automatically generated changelog.

git_log_to.description: Ending git commit SHA for automatically generated changelog.

git_tag.description: Git tag associated with this build.

gray_completed_at.description: When gray completed (full push). Null means allowlist-only.

gray_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between coverage ticks. k = floor(elapsed / interval).

gray_start_percent.description: Starting gray coverage percent at t=0. 100 (default) publishes as full push.

gray_step_percent.description: Coverage percent added after each interval tick.

is_critical.description: True if this release contains urgent security fixes; forces immediate update and ignores gray rollout.

is_lts.description: True if this version is marked as a Long-Term Support release.

lines.description: Platform slices included on GET version detail.

min_source_version.description: Oldest source version permitted to upgrade directly to this version without passing through an intermediate.

publish_time.description: UTC timestamp when the version was published.

version_integer.description: Integer build number (must be unique within the project).

version_semver.description: Semantic version string compliant with SemVer 2.0 (unique ignoring build metadata).

VersionExists.description: Response indicating whether a specific version exists in the project repository.

channel.description: Distribution channel of the existing version.

exists.description: True if the version exists in this project.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the version.

VersionLine.description: Platform-specific slice (os, arch) belonging to a Version.

artifacts.description: Artifacts on this platform slice (present on GET .../lines).

min_api_level.description: Minimum API level for this line. Combined with min_os using AND when both are set.

min_os.description: Minimum operating system for this line (digits with optional dots). Null means unrestricted.

platform_notes.description: Platform-specific release notes or installation instructions.

packs_ready_at.description: When system preheat (auto_delta, channel × delta_source_count) finished. Null means check/feed cannot see this line yet.

VersionLineCreateInput.description: Declare a platform slice. When the project matrix is non-empty, os/arch must match a matrix row (400 otherwise).

min_api_level.description: Optional minimum API level for the new line.

min_os.description: Minimum operating system required for this slice.

VersionListOutput.description: Envelope returned by GET /api/v1/admin/projects/{project_ref}/versions. latest is present only when latest=true (or 1) together with os and arch.

latest.description: Present only when latest=true|1 and both os and arch are set. Max published+ready version for that pair, or null if none. Omitted on filtered and unfiltered lists.

versions.description: Project versions after AND filters (channel, status, os, arch). os+arch means the version has that line in any status. List items omit full line payloads.

VersionPatchInput.description: Request payload to update release notes or metadata on an existing version.

changelog.description: Optional default changelog Markdown string (handler field changelog *string). Locale map goes in changelog_i18n.

git_log_from.description: Start git commit for changelog range.

git_log_to.description: End git commit for changelog range.

VersionPutInput.description: Request payload to idempotently create or update a draft version.

changelog.description: Optional default changelog Markdown string (handler field changelog *string). Locale map goes in changelog_i18n.

git_log_to.description: End git commit for changelog range.

gray_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between coverage ticks. k = floor(elapsed / interval).

gray_start_percent.description: Starting gray coverage percent at t=0. 100 (default) publishes as full push.

gray_step_percent.description: Coverage percent added after each interval tick.

is_critical.description: Mark version as critical update (disables gray rollout).

min_source_version.description: Oldest version that can update directly.

WebhookDelivery.description: Audit log of an HTTP webhook notification sent upon version lifecycle events.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the webhook event was generated.

delivered_at.description: Timestamp when the webhook was successfully delivered.

last_error.description: Error message from the last delivery attempt.

last_status_code.description: HTTP status code received from the destination endpoint.

line_id.description: Associated version line UUID if line-specific.

payload.description: Event data envelope body as delivered

WebhookDeliveryListOutput.description: Paginated list of webhook delivery records.

next_cursor.description: Cursor token for retrieving the next page of deliveries.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque administrator session token issued after completing login 2FA. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Pending 2FA tokens use the same header on /auth/2fa/* enrollment and verify routes.

projectTokenAuth.description: Project-scoped API token passed via X-Project-Token header or Authorization: Bearer <token>.
projectTokenAuth.name: X-Project-Token

info.description: KiriVers admin-plane API: session authentication and 2FA, project and version management, artifacts, gray rollout, registered clients, announcements, GeoIP, and store listings. Software-client traffic (check, download, feeds) lives on the client plane.

Invalidates unused codes and returns a new set once.
Issues a full session from optional_passkey stage.
